rule: ADR-355 (charter: a turn that reached the model and ended on its own)
what: F7's Plover create turn on Opus: it reached the model, ended on its own after 1310.0 s, and spent F7's create slot -- but it built no biped, because the engine's project-worker bundle was poisoned under the live turn by this repo's own iteration-158 source edit. The accepted design is a three-solid probe script.

measured.note: Unavailable, not passing: the accepted revision places no assembly component, so there is no pair to measure. The biped was never accepted.

latest_candidate.error: The isolated domain worker exited without a result.

cause.kind: engine mutated under a live turn (not a provider limit, not a model failure)
cause.traceback: cadex_project_worker.py line 31: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'CadexGeometryDigest'
cause.explanation: The CLI's dev-tree engine root IS the live source tree (cli/cadex_cli/engine.py DEV_MODULE_DIR = src/Mod/cadex). cadexd imports CadexScriptedRuntime once, at session start, and keeps its _DOMAIN_WORKER_BUNDLES member list in memory; shared_worker_bundle then reads each member's bytes from disk on every cache miss. Iteration 158 (ADR-389, commit ece37fa6) added the CadexGeometryDigest import to cadex_project_worker.py while this turn was live, so the resident cadexd hashed the NEW worker bytes against its OLD member list, produced a hash that had never existed, and published a 32-member bundle holding a worker that imports a module the bundle does not carry. Being content-addressed, that bundle is recomputed identically on every retry, so no rebuild in the turn could recover.
cause.engine_sound_now: A bundle staged from today's source carries all 33 members including CadexGeometryDigest.py, and test_cadexd_lifecycle.py is 23 passed against the dev tree.

window_cost.note: Beside ot7-plover-c's ~17 points for 1800 s at a lower start. An Opus create turn is far cheaper in window than the Fable turn the 45 % gate was calibrated on.

ruling: Recorded as a spent create slot, the receipt's own reading. The charter voids a call only on a provider usage, session or credit limit; an engine mutated by this repo's own unattended work is not in that list, and the actor does not invent a category for it. F7 therefore stands at one spent create turn with three continuations unspent on ot7-plover-d -- whose accepted design is a probe, so a continuation there continues from a probe and not from a biped. Whether that reading survives is the critic's or the owner's call, not this receipt's.
process_fact: Never edit src/Mod/cadex while a design turn is live. The dev-tree engine root is the source tree, and a resident cadexd mixes its in-memory module list with on-disk bytes.
